Title: Generally Available: Application Gateway upgrades with no performance impact

Body.Content:
Azure Application Gateway now performs upgrades without any degradation in performance. During an upgrade, it automatically provisions new gateway instances to maintain the same pre-upgrade capacity. This ensures: 

  • No impact on performance 
  • Full traffic handling throughout the upgrade 

This enhancement strengthens resiliency and reliability for mission-critical applications, ensuring consistent performance even during infrastructure updates. 

Learn more.
